question: Which mantra formula secures Kālikā's constant protection of the practitioner's secret part?
premises: The bīja krīṃ is invoked in the formula.
The practitioner requests protection of the secret part.
Salutation is offered to Kālikā for this protection.
inference: The krīṃ-mantra with salutation to Kālikā is invoked to protect the secret part always.
plain_english: Krīṃ—salutation to Kālikā—may she always protect my secret part; then.
